Class ScenarioRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.ScenarioRepository
public class ScenarioRepository extends Object
Repository for storing and retrieving Scenario instances.

Provides methods to add scenarios, fetch a scenario by name, and retrieve all stored scenarios. Ensures duplicate prevention via internal validation and protects internal state through defensive copies. Includes file persistence functionality to save and load scenarios from "ScenarioStorage" file.
